book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: قلت لحالي: خلص، ما بسافر بعد.
sentences.en: I said to myself: enough, I will not travel again.

sentences.ar: بس الخليفة طلب مني أروح لسرنديب.
sentences.en: But the caliph asked me to go to Serendib.
I could not refuse the caliph’s request.
I arrived and delivered the gift and rested a little.
And on the way back, sea robbers attacked us.
They sold me as a slave in a far city.

sentences.ar: اشتراني تاجر طيب وسألني: شو بتعرف تعمل؟
sentences.en: A kind merchant bought me and asked: what do you know how to do?
